scope.targetCreation: explicit administrator provisioning before operator starts

journal.authority: full contiguous online replay from independently pinned signed genesis
journal.commit: one complete canonical record at one fixed slot using conditional If-None-Match:*
journal.retention: version-pinned COMPLIANCE receipt on every slot
journal.lostAcknowledgement: resolve only the same slot and exact canonical record after full replay; never rebase a candidate

gateway.authentication: pinned mTLS identity with exact log and record-kind capabilities
operations: conditional append to fixed canonical slot
gateway.unsafeOperations: no delete, copy, unconditional put, multipart or transparent proxy endpoints
gateway.storage: official AWS SDK v2; trial SeaweedFS with versioning, COMPLIANCE retention and synchronous filer storage rule

authority.transitionAuthorization: current independent administrator key, exact expected cursor and authority digest
authority.historicalKeyRoles: one signing key cannot cross administrator, publisher, witness and fencer roles
authority.publisherRotation: new policy epoch and full newly signed snapshot activated atomically in the same journal record
authority.readKeyRotation: new read-key epoch and full reencrypted snapshot; new reader wraps exclude revoked nodes
authority.nodeKeyRotation: new immutable node key and trust Secret, new signed enrollment and bootstrap generation; replacing a node key alone does not revoke a disclosed read key
authority.witnessRotation: new independently delivered witness pin; old pin is never upgraded from incoming head bytes
authority.administratorRotation: old current administrator signs the new independent administrator; old administrator cannot authorize subsequent transitions
authority.fencerRotation: new fencer epoch and signing keys invalidate grants under the previous authority
authority.panelProjection: derived cache only, from fresh nonce-bound full authority proof under an independently pinned current witness key
authority.rollbackRestore: new explicitly signed recovery transition and new canonical sequence; never decrement sequence or epochs

recovery.plan: independently administrator-signed exact online cursor, snapshot, enrollment, CR and Store identities and generations, binding identity, new state UID, bootstrap generation and expected protected-state digest
recovery.initialize: explicit signed operation, previous generation zero, new generation one, no previous state UID, absent state.json
recovery.recover: explicit signed operation, newer bootstrap generation and different precreated state Secret UID
recovery.dataTransport: encrypted envelope and signed encrypted reader wrap exports; fresh online witness proofs and journal replay remain mandatory
phases: persist prepared protected checkpoint and rollout authorization
CAS verified target bytes and metadata
recovery.preparedState: normal runtime is blocked with RecoveryPending
recovery.concurrentCanonicalCommit: journal checks and Kubernetes CAS are separate; a verified target can temporarily lag a concurrent commit, finalization stays RecoveryPending and needs a newly reviewed exact-cursor plan
recovery.retry: only the same verified plan and durable chosen revision; already persisted target writes are resolved by exact content and metadata
recovery.supersedingPreparedPlan: a new independently signed exact-cursor plan must bind the exact prepared state digest; completed state cannot be reset in the same generation
recovery.rolloutDefault: invalidate historical pending intent; preserve data revision for equal selected bytes
recovery.rolloutOptIn: separate signed allow_rollout plus installation and CR permission, only for actual selected-data change

fencing.acquisition: projected token audience sekvyr-fence, TokenReview bound Pod and ServiceAccount UIDs, registered namespace and Lease UIDs, fresh exact process Lease holder on every CAS retry
fencing.processIdentity: fixed at operator process startup; a stale process cannot learn and adopt a later holder identity
fencing.grant: signed scope, genesis, installation, bootstrap generation, owner Pod UID, exact process Lease holder, monotonic term, previous grant hash, current authority digest, exact canonical snapshot and complete exact object UID set
fencing.snapshotAdvance: invalidate previous grant even for equal plaintext; obtain a new term and metadata-only barriers before ordinary writes
fencing.activation: server signs and journals activation only after installing and rereading every object barrier
fencing.partialPromotion: deny ordinary writes until activation is complete
fencing.writerSession: immutable per reconciliation, bound to the exact grant hash; never copied from later object annotations
fencing.dataHeadGate: accepted E2E2 snapshot head must equal the separate online replay-verified journal head before new checkpoint or data authorization is persisted

admission.scope: fixed namespace and object names, no mutable objectSelector
admission.ordinaryWrite: active current journal grant, authenticated bound Pod UID, unchanged exact fence, fixed write-session hash and exact object UID/resourceVersion
admission.barrierWrite: only registered fencer ServiceAccount, increasing term, exact current grant, fence-only metadata mutation
admission.administrator: explicit configured exact bootstrap subjects, no wildcard groups
admission.deadlineParameter: only POST /admit accepts the API server's single canonical timeout=1..30s; all other query parameters and routes reject it

fencing.delayedApprovedWrite: resourceVersion conflict after that object's newer barrier; writes before each barrier linearize before its promotion
fencing.kubernetesAssumption: honest API server with resourceVersion CAS and monotonic revisions; no surviving already-approved request across raw etcd revision rewind is claimed

outages.panel: retain last verified target and application; no historical or duplicate rollout
outages.witness: deny new data and rollout writes without fresh proof
outages.journalOrGateway: deny grants, activation, ordinary fenced admission and recovery
outages.fencerOrWebhook: deny fenced writes; already running application retains its Secret
outages.restoredPanelDatabase: cannot lower canonical journal or protected checkpoint
outages.restoredKubernetesState: live canonical grant and exact UID barriers reject stale writer; explicit administrator recovery required for lost state

nonClaims: A single test cluster does not prove independent production storage, administrator or backup fault domains
Trial Object Lock behavior is not a certification of physical WORM storage
One honest logical witness is assumed; no custom Byzantine quorum is implemented
Previously disclosed plaintext or read keys cannot be recalled
No cross-object transaction or exactly-once workload restart is claimed
No compatibility with older binaries after a new recovery state or authority policy is claimed
